(section) s. 995.70 (created)
(quote) Proof of identity for purchase of schedule II and III controlled substances. [s. 450.11, stats.] The bill specifies that a tribal identification card is sufficient identification for purposes of a law only if it includes the full name, address, and birth date of the card holder, a photograph of the card holder, and any other information required by the law.
(other) LRB analysis (printed with the bill): The bill provides that identification cards issued by an American Indian tribe or band must be accepted as sufficient proof of identity for the purpose of any law that requires a person to present identification.
(other) LRB analysis (printed with the bill): The bill includes provisions relating to enforcement that are modeled on provisions of the state open records law.
